headline: New Wearable Ultrasound Patch Boosts REM Sleep Without Drugs or Surgery
reason: Developed by University of Texas researchers and reported on November 16, 2026, this revolutionary wearable patch uses gentle ultrasound to stimulate deep brain regions, helping participants enter REM sleep an average of 43 minutes faster and remain there 16 minutes longer. This human-centric research offers a non-invasive and actionable protocol for improving sleep quality, a critical factor in healthspan and longevity.

headline: PM Modi Announces 500 Million Indians Lifted Out of Poverty, Citing World Bank Report
